name: Youth Spirit Artworks job training
what_you_do: Arts training and paid jobs for low-income and homeless youth.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 25, low-income or homeless youth (per the Berkeley Public Library jobs page).
notes: Ages and contact come from the library page. The group's home page shows free arts workshops and drop-in events for ages 14 to 25 but no job training details, so ask about jobs. Not on the City of Oakland's 2026 summer jobs list.
